unavailable.title: Not available here
unavailable.body: This copy of the site runs without a database, so rooms and rankings are turned off.

profile.label: Your name
profile.placeholder: A name the others will see
profile.note: No account needed. Your player lives in this browser.
profile.invalid: Pick a name with at least one letter.

race.label: Race, room {code}
race.giveUpBody: You keep the rounds you solved and go to the table. You cannot come back to this race.
race.rules: Each hint adds 30 seconds to your time. A revealed puzzle counts as not solved.
race.revealBody: The puzzle solves itself and counts as not solved. Whoever solved more rounds finishes ahead, whatever the time.
race.roundSaved: Round done. Next one coming up.

room.title: Challenge room
room.missingBody: Rooms last a day and a half. Ask for a new link, or open a room of your own.
room.over: This race is over. Here is how it went.
room.inviteBody: Send the link. Everyone who opens it lands in this room.
room.shareText: Race me on Minigames: {rounds, plural, one {# puzzle} other {# puzzles}}, same boards for everyone.
room.startAlone: You can start alone, or wait for someone to join.
room.clockNote: Your clock starts when your first board appears and only stops when your last round is done, even if you leave the page.
room.waitingOthers: You are done. The others are still racing.

setup.title: Challenge friends
setup.blurb: Open a room, pick the puzzles and send the link. Everyone gets the same boards and races to finish them.
setup.failed: The room could not be opened. Try again.
setup.tooMany: Too many rooms in the last hour. Try again later.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.empty: Nobody has scored yet. Solve a daily puzzle to open the ranking.
ranking.rulesPoints: Daily puzzles only: 100 points for solving, minus 10 per hint, plus up to 50 for speed. Practice and challenge rooms do not count.
ranking.rulesTime: Fastest solves of today's puzzle. Each hint counts as 30 seconds.
ranking.hubEmpty: No scores this week yet. The first daily puzzle solved takes the lead.
ranking.challengeBody: Race the same puzzles against friends, live.
